chunks.arabic_text: مَعَانِي الْأَخْبَارِ: وَبِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ عَنِ ابْنِ عِيسَى، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الْبَرِيْدِ الْعَجَلِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: مَا أَدْنَى مَا يَصِيرُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ كَافِرًا؟

translations.en: Ma'ani al-Akhbar: With this chain from Ibn Isa, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Udhayna, from Burayd al-Ijli who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): What is the least thing by which the slave becomes Kafir?

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ: فَأَخَذَ حَصَاةً مِنَ الْأَرْضِ فَقَالَ: أَنْ يَقُولَ لِهَذِهِ الْحَصَاةِ: إِنَّهَا نَوَاةٌ، وَيُبَرِّئَ مِمَّنْ خَالَفَهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ، وَيَدِينَ اللَّهَ بِالْبَرَاءَةِ مِمَّنْ قَالَ بِغَيْرِ قَوْلِهِ، فَهَذَا نَاصِبٌ قَدْ أَشْرَكَ بِاللَّهِ وَكَفَرَ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُ.

translations.en: He said: That he says about this pebble, 'It is a date-stone,' and disassociates from anyone who opposes him in that, and he worships Allah by disassociating from the one who professes a belief other than his own, so this is a hostile opponent (Nasib) who has ascribed partners to Allah and disbelieved without knowing.

en.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) explains the minimum threshold for a person to become a disbeliever (Kafir) through the concept of 'Tajassus' or intellectual arrogance, where one asserts a belief about a trivial object (like a pebble being a date-stone) and demands others follow it, while disassociating from those who disagree. This act of claiming divine authority over minor matters and rejecting others is equated to Shirk (associating partners with God) and Kufr, even if the person is unaware of the gravity of their action.
en.seo_question: What is the minimum act that makes a Muslim a disbeliever according to Imam al-Sadiq?

key_terms.نَاصِبٌ: Hostile opponent (specifically of the Ahl al-Bayt)
